# Hash-pinned CI-tooling dependencies for publish-python-sdk.yml's "Install
# build" step. `build` 1.6.0 on Python 3.12/Linux with no extras pulls in
# exactly `packaging` and `pyproject_hooks` (its other requires_dist entries
# are Windows-only, py<3.10.2-only, py<3.11-only, or extras-gated) and both
# are leaf packages with zero further dependencies, so this file's closure
# is complete. Installed with `pip install --require-hashes -r
# .github/publish-requirements.txt`. All three ship a single universal
# `py3-none-any` wheel, so one hash per package covers every platform.
# Hashes are the sha256 digests PyPI reports for those wheels, taken from
# https://pypi.org/pypi/<package>/<version>/json. Regenerate when bumping
# any of these versions.

    --hash=sha256:f7aaf1ebbb79178a02ba248bb524f2176b256017e17e8e4bd4289c7b38cc2bad
